summary.text: C.D. Davidsmeyer has represented the 100th District in the Illinois House since December 2012, and the legislature lists Davidsmeyer as Assistant Minority Leader.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography says Davidsmeyer was born and raised in Jacksonville and holds a B.A. in Political Science from Miami University of Ohio.
Davidsmeyer served on the Jacksonville City Council from 2008 to 2012.
